result:
PR #613 pushed and merged into the branch's history is up to date. Final summary:

**PR #613**: https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/613

Before writing code, I confirmed two of the four SCOPE items already existed and left them alone: the designer-wise Budget-vs-Actual cut (`byDesigner` in `aggregateDesignerTimesheetCosts`, PR #597) and a full KPI designer-fills/manager-approves workflow (`construction-kpi-service.ts`). The real gap was that `pms_time_entries` had no approval-status field at all, so I built:

- Schema: `approvalStatus` (draft/submitted/approved/rejected) + `approvedById`/`approvedAt`/`rejectionReason` on `pmsTimeEntries`, plus hand-written migration `drizzle/0268_*.sql` (drizzle-kit's generator can't be used here — same documented snapshot gap as migration 0267).
- Service: `submitTimeEntry`/`approveTimeEntry`/`rejectTimeEntry` in `pms-time-service.ts`, modeled on `construction-kpi-service.ts`'s existing pattern — self-approval blocked, state transitions enforced.
- API: `/api/pms/time-entries/[id]/{submit,approve,reject}`, approve/reject gated with `requireRole(dbUser, "manager")`.
- Two new reports registered in the existing `REPORT_REGISTRY`: `designer-approval-status` (designer-wise status view) and `work-analysis` (hours by task/category per designer over a period).

Verified `tsc --noEmit` clean and full `bun test` at 2244 pass/0 fail, including every pre-existing PR #597 test unmodified. Per this task's protocol, it is **not self-merged** — it needs a fresh supervisor audit before merge.
